capture_rule: Capture every byte and every compound, citation, dataset, property, variable, constraint, phase, uncertainty and point from each complete NIST ThermoML source. Construct the empirical vector from every direct-value viscosity point in those sources. Preserve every density, interfacial-tension and other companion dataset but exclude it from viscosity measurements. Do not select substances, mixtures, phases, compositions, temperatures, pressures, methods, datasets or rows within a source.
source_selection_boundary: The three complete authoritative sources are fixed before any measured value, uncertainty or target hash is captured and before executable-law registration, candidate enumeration or prediction-program construction. The selection spans pure, binary and ternary chemical systems, broad composition/temperature/pressure support and multiple direct viscometry methods without using a result value.
